newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE details April certified coffee stock data.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE details April certified coffee stock data.

text.p: LIFFE certified coffee stocks rose to 4,858 five-tonne lots in April from 4,008 in March, the exchange said on Thursday.
As forecast, the largest increase was posted in warehouses in New Orleans, U.S. The stocks rose to 1,266 lots from 570 in March.
Exchange officials said the certified coffee was valid for May delivery only, which expires on May 31.
LIFFE's new grading terms come into effect with the July contract onwards.
The 4,858 lots graded in April cease to be valid if not tendered by the end of this month.

For May coffee, members have an option of grading under the new or the old system, which expires at the of this month. Coffee graded under the old rules will have to be re-graded, which would incur additional costs.
